cues.en: Congratulations for making it to the end!
cues.zh: 恭喜你完成整門課！

cues.en: Recommender systems are a broad area that sometimes involves some challenging math, algorithms, and concepts.
cues.zh: 推薦系統是個廣泛的領域，有時涉及具挑戰性的數學、演算法與概念。

cues.en: But remember, it's the simpler approaches that tend to work best, in my experience.
cues.zh: 但記得，以我的經驗，往往是較簡單的方法效果最好。

cues.en: With the advent of deep learning and the resurgence in AI, recommender systems will continue to evolve quickly, and you need to stay on top of the latest developments.
cues.zh: 隨著深度學習出現、AI 再度興起，推薦系統將持續快速演進，你需要掌握最新發展。

cues.en: ACM's RecSys conference is a great way to stay on top of the latest research in the field.
cues.zh: ACM 的 RecSys 會議，是掌握這個領域最新研究的好方法。

cues.en: Even if you can't afford to attend in person, it's pretty cheap to join the Association for Computing Machinery and just purchase access to the publications of the SIGKDD group, that's the special
cues.zh: 即使無法負擔親自參加，加入 Association for Computing Machinery，並購買 SIGKDD 群組的出版內容存取權，也相當便宜。這是，

cues.en: interest group for Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining, and that gives you access to publications related to recommendation systems online, including the proceedings from every RecSys conference
cues.zh: 知識探索與資料探勘的特別興趣小組，讓你能在線上存取推薦系統相關出版內容，包括每一屆 RecSys 會議，

cues.en: that ever happened.
cues.zh: 歷年舉辦的會議論文集。

cues.en: It's only $25 per year as of now.
cues.zh: 以目前錄課時的價格，每年只要 25 美元。

cues.en: If you'd like to learn more about the oldie but goodie techniques of collaborative filtering, a classic title is Programming Collective Intelligence by Toby Segaran, published by O'Reilly.
cues.zh: 如果想了解更多協同過濾這類經典好用的技術，一本經典著作是 Toby Segaran 撰寫、O'Reilly 出版的 Programming Collective Intelligence。

cues.en: Books specifically about recommender systems are very few and far between, but another option is the Recommender Systems Handbook.
cues.zh: 專門介紹推薦系統的書非常少，另一個選擇是 Recommender Systems Handbook。

cues.en: It's not cheap, $240 for a hardcover copy, but it's over 1,000 pages of papers that cover every aspect of recommender systems in great depth.
cues.zh: 它不便宜，精裝版要 240 美元，但有超過一千頁的論文，深入涵蓋推薦系統的各個面向。

cues.en: It's structured as a collection of papers written by a variety of practitioners in the field, but it's well organized and contains a lot of valuable information.
cues.zh: 它由這個領域各種實務工作者撰寫的論文組成，但組織良好，包含大量寶貴資訊。

cues.en: The only problem is that books like this are obsolete before they even get published; you won't find any insight in here on applying neural networks or modern tools such as Tensorflow,
cues.zh: 唯一問題是，這類書甚至還沒出版就已經過時。書中找不到將神經網路，或 TensorFlow 這類現代工具，

cues.en: Amazon DSSTNE, or SageMaker.
cues.zh: 以及 Amazon DSSTNE、SageMaker，應用到推薦系統的見解。

cues.en: Many of the topics are timeless, but you'll want to augment what you learn in this book with more current research from the RecSys conference or by keeping an eye on what deep learning technologies
cues.zh: 許多主題歷久彌新，但仍應透過 RecSys 會議的更新研究，或持續關注深度學習技術，

cues.en: are being offered by the industry giants such as Amazon and Google.
cues.zh: 例如 Amazon、Google 等業界巨頭提供的技術，補充書中學到的知識。

cues.en: Anyhow, remember this is only the beginning!
cues.zh: 總之，記得這只是開始！

cues.en: It's a fascinating field, and one that's always evolving.
cues.zh: 這是迷人而且不斷演進的領域。

cues.en: While you've reached the end of this course, don't think of it as the end of your learning about recommender systems, think of it as getting caught up on the current state of the art.
cues.zh: 雖然課程結束了，但別把它當作學習推薦系統的終點，而要視為已經掌握目前的先進技術。

cues.en: And now, you can join the excitement in the field as it discovers new ways to better understand individuals and the things that they love.
cues.zh: 現在，你可以加入這個令人興奮的領域，一起發現新的方法，更了解每個人，以及他們喜愛的事物。

cues.en: You've learned a huge amount of valuable knowledge, and you should be proud.
cues.zh: 你已經學到大量寶貴知識，應該為自己感到驕傲。

cues.en: Thank you for sticking with me until the end, and don't forget to leave a review!
cues.zh: 謝謝你一路跟到最後，也別忘了留下評價！

cues.en: Your written reviews are really essential to my success.
cues.zh: 你的文字評論，對我的成功非常重要。

cues.en: Now go forth, and help people discover wonderful things!
cues.zh: 現在就出發，幫助人們發現美好的事物吧！
